{{Quote|It's the Bleeders again. Used to just drag tourists off and harvest a body part or two. Now they're rich, armed and getting ambitious.|[[Rarkgah]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''"Bleeder" gangs''' were groups of criminals that were employed in the [[organ harvesting]] business on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Bleeders were especially prevalent in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]], and controlled much of the black market trade for organs and other body parts and processed and distributed [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="TOR" />
